text:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary rollout initiated for inference-router @region-eu and @region-us. traffic split 10% eu / 5% us. image: redwood/inference-router:v2026.06. Canary window 15m.

oliver (oncall): seeing error spike on canary in eu. 5xxs up ~12% over baseline. rolling logs show repeated OOM in router-proxy. tagging maya and raj.

maya (runtime): pulling logs, looks like a new header parsing code path causing a mem growth in warmup for certain request shapes. low-sample but high latency.

raj (sre): pinging infra autoscaler -- memory keeptaking on canary nodes. if it's OOM we should kill the canary flag and halt traffic. recommend feature-flag kill-switch and 100% drain to baseline.

inc-bot: Paging oliver (oncall), raj (sre) — incident created: INC-2026-563. Current severity: SEV2.

oliver (oncall): agreed. executing kill-switch for feature flag ff.router-new-header-parser now. @deploy-bot can you stop traffic injection into canary?

deploy-bot: Received action. Pausing canary traffic and initiating rollback plan alpha. Current canary endpoints: eu-canary-12, us-canary-7.

maya (runtime): quick note — the code included an experimental header cache that can leak when upstream compresses chunked responses. I'm worried about side effects if we just kill pods; prefer graceful drain + rollback to previous image.

raj (sre): plan: 1) pause traffic (done), 2) disable ff (done), 3) scale canary down to 0 with grace 60s, 4) roll back service to v2026.05 in eu and us, 5) smoke-sanity checks, 6) monitor for regression. anyone object?

carlos (support): we already have 3 customer reports in EU complaining about failures for embedded search. ETA on rollback? Customers impacted: small set of EU customers using embedded-search pipeline, about ~120 requests/min.

sophie (product): flagging SLAs and outreach — support to prepare template message. prioritize EU customers and mention transient errors.

oliver (oncall): starting manual rollback to v2026.05 on eu first, then us. issuing commands now:

```bash
# rollback eu
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference-router inference-router=redwood/inference-router:v2026.05 --record
kubectl rollout status deploy/inference-router -n inference --timeout=5m
```

maya (runtime): while rolling back, please ensure KV cache warm-up is disabled on startup to avoid heavy mem pressure. runners use env RW_CACHE_WARM=false for rollback pods.

raj (sre): applying env override to rollout: `kubectl set env deploy/inference RW_CACHE_WARM=false -n inference`. also patching HPA scale down bounds to avoid flapping.

deploy-bot: eu rollout to v2026.05 started. 4 pods terminating, 4 new pods creating. healthchecks show 3/4 ready so far.

oliver (oncall): monitoring metrics dashboard: latency back to baseline in eu within ~90s of first ready pod. 5xxs down from 12% -> 1.2% across the cluster.

carlos (support): pushing notification to affected customers draft: "We're investigating transient errors with inference-powered search in EU; we've reverted a recent deployment and are monitoring. Expect improvements shortly. Reach support if you see continued errors."

maya (runtime): confirming crash-loop stops after rollback and env change. logs show header cache code path not executed because old image present. good.

raj (sre): after eu successful rollback, initiating us rollback now (traffic was lower but we still had a few failing requests). same steps executed.

deploy-bot: us rollback complete. healthchecks green. Canary cluster drained.

oliver (oncall): next: verification checklist (runbook):
- run synthetic smoke tests against inference-router endpoints (succeeded)
- run long-tail request shapes test (running)
- check memory profiles on new pods (ok)
- confirm no new alerts on pager duty (none)

sophie (product): good — let's run a short canary with 2% traffic using v2026.05 + monitoring for 30m before reattempting any new changes. also schedule post-mortem with runtime + sres + release engineers.

maya (runtime): root cause hypothesis: header parser change + cache warm-up triggered memory usage for chunked compressed responses. will open PR to fix and add unit/regression tests.

raj (sre): actions created: INC-2026-563-1 (postmortem), INC-2026-563-2 (rollback verification), and follow-up runbook updates for feature-flag kill-switch in multi-region staggered rollouts.

oliver (oncall): handing off to maya and raj for long-tail verification. I'm going offline for change window. anyone else oncall now? @raj please take lead.

raj (sre): taking lead. will keep the thread updated every 15m or on notable state changes. current severity -> SEV3 (recovering).

carlos (support): will send customer update note now. cc: @sophie for messaging sign-off.

inc-bot: Incident INC-2026-563 status updated: recovered -> monitoring. Postmortem template created at /wiki/incidents/INC-2026-563.

maya (runtime): opened PR #879 to revert header cache change and add a unit test for chunked compressed response. linking in postmortem.

oliver (oncall): thanks team. leave this thread open until postmortem complete. :thumbsup:
